'''Jimmy's Typhlosion''' (Japanese: '''ケンタのバクフーン''' ''Kenta's Bakphoon'') was {{jo|Jimmy}}'s [[first partner Pokémon]], given to him as a {{p|Cyndaquil}} by [[Professor Elm]].

==History==
[[File:LoT first partners.png|thumb|250px|left|Jimmy picking Cyndaquil to be his [[first partner Pokémon]]]]
===Pre-series===
Jimmy obtained Cyndaquil from [[Professor Elm]] on the same day that [[Vincent]] got his [[Vincent's Meganium|Chikorita]] and {{jo|Marina}} got her [[Wani-Wani|Totodile]]. 

Cyndaquil would soon become one of his closest Pokémon. At the very beginning of his {{pkmn|journey}}, Jimmy used Cyndaquil to battle {{ga|Silver}}, but he was defeated by the power of his rival's {{p|Nidoking}}.

The defeat made them decide to become increasingly strong and Cyndaquil soon evolved into a {{p|Quilava}} and some time later into a {{p|Typhlosion}}. Thanks to his arduous training, the duo eventually managed to defeat Silver, which brought the two even closer.

===''[[The Legend of Thunder!]]''===
Jimmy used Typhlosion to defeat {{OBP|Shinji|The Legend of Thunder!}} and his powerful {{p|Hitmonlee}}. After a hard-fought battle, Typhlosion and Jimmy emerged victorious and then complimented Shinji and his Pokémon. 

Later, Typhlosion was used in Jimmy's battle against Marina and [[Wani-Wani]], where Typhlosion shrugged off {{m|Water Gun}} despite the type disadvantage. The battle was then interrupted because of [[Team Rocket]]'s mission to capture {{OBP|Raikou|The Legend of Thunder!}}.
[[File:Jimmy Typhlosion laugh.png|220px|thumb|Typhlosion laughing]]
Jimmy then used Typhlosion to battle [[Attila]]'s {{p|Skarmory}} and [[Hun]]'s {{p|Steelix}}, but it was defeated by {{type|Ground}} attacks and Steelix and Skarmory's combined attacks. In order to protect Jimmy, Typhlosion tried to battle the wounded Raikou, but Jimmy stopped it. After retrieving its energy, Typhlosion was used again to save Raikou from the clutches of Team Rocket, and Typhlosion used its Fire attack, alongside the attacks of {{TP|Vincent|Meganium}} and [[Little Miss]], to try and destroy Team Rocket's machine.

Jimmy used Typhlosion once again in order to save Raikou from the machine, and it used all of its strength to save the Legendary Pokémon alongside Meganium. Typhlosion was later seen with Jimmy, his friends, and their Pokémon as they said goodbye to Raikou while the Legendary Pokémon went on its own way.

===''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''===
In ''[[JN116|Pride of a Champion!]]'', Typhlosion appeared watching the [[Masters Eight Tournament]] match between {{an|Lance}} and [[Diantha]] on TV.
{{-}}

==Personality and characteristics==
[[File:Jimmy and Typhlosion.png|left|thumb|220px|Typhlosion and Jimmy]]
Like {{Ash}} and his {{AP|Pikachu}}, Jimmy and Typhlosion are very close to each other. In ''[[The Legend of Thunder!]]'', it was seen [[Walking Pokémon|out of its Poké Ball]] most of the time. Like Jimmy, one of Typhlosion's defining traits is its immense willpower, and it doesn't like to give up, even in the face of danger.

As a friend, Typhlosion likes to battle for fun, and is aware of Jimmy's feelings for Marina. Nevertheless, it is extremely loyal to Jimmy, to the point of confronting the power of a Legendary Pokémon even though seriously wounded after a battle.
{{-}}
